The site's heading font DUTCHI (@font-face in elementor/css/post-88.css: DUTCH-2.ttf, DUTCHB.ttf) is a Times-style serif. Tinos is its free look-alike: metrically compatible with Times New Roman, licence SIL OFL 1.1 (the LICENSE file shipped with the font), files copied into src/fonts/ from the npm package @fontsource/tinos 5.3.0 and served by the app itself (upstream: Google Fonts / Steve Matteson). No runtime request leaves the app for fonts

copied on 2026-10-07 from https://roseskebablands.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/RosesKababLand_Logo_Heder.png: the homepage header logo and the site's og:image. It is the best-quality logo file the site serves: 172×128 is the original upload (the page uses it at full size, no larger rendition exists); the wide wordmark "Roses-Kebab-Land Persian-Grill1.png" (809×152) referenced in the menu pages' header returns 404 under every URL encoding; favicon R1.png (161×141) is the red R alone; the homepage GIF (480×270, 95 frames) is a background animation, not a logo. A vector logo is still a pending client input.
